name: YMU v1.1.10
bodySnippet:
# v1.1.10 - In-App Restart Hotfix

Version 1.1.10 is a targeted hotfix addressing an issue where restarting YMU from within the app (such as after changing languages or updating translations) could cause internet connection and SSL errors.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> To update, simply **download v1.1.10
